title: Generative AI for Accessible and Inclusive Extended Reality

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis and literature review highlighting the risk of replicating gender stereotypes when generating 2D and 3D content for Extended Reality (XR) environments.

Qualitative discussion referencing recent media incidents (e.g., Google Gemini generating historically inaccurate depictions) and literature to evaluate the risks of racial stereotyping and foundation model biases.

Conceptual evaluation of how AI-generated 3D content might exclude users with visual, motor, or speech impairments if proper alternative rendering metadata and multiple accessible interaction paradigms (e.g., gaze, speech, multimodal) are not maintained.
